name: codepop
description: CodePop: kid-friendly C++ and HTML learning app with level challenges, groups, a Top 10 and AI-copy detection.

scripts.build: cd build && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && node build.js
scripts.pages: npm run build && mkdir -p docs && cp dist/index.html docs/index.html && touch docs/.nojekyll
scripts.test: node test/cpp.test.js && node test/html.test.js && node test/core.test.js && node test/ui.test.js && node test/arena.test.js && node test/github.test.js && node test/server.test.js
